map.LTV（Customer Lifetime Value，客户终身价值）是指客户在: LTV (Customer Lifetime Value) is the total value a customer brings to a business over the whole relationship. It is the core measure of customer value and of whether marketing spend pays off.
map.LTV = 平均客单价 × 年购买频次 × 客户生命周期 × 毛利率: LTV = average order value × annual purchase frequency × customer lifetime × gross margin
map.LTV = (月均收入 × 毛利率) / 月流失率: LTV = (average monthly revenue × gross margin) / monthly churn rate
map.例如：月均收入99元，毛利率70%，月流失率5%，则 LTV = (99 × 0: For example with average monthly revenue 99 CNY, gross margin 70% and monthly churn 5%, LTV = (99 × 0.7) / 0.05 = ¥1,386

map.客单价 100、年购 12 次、生命周期 3 年、毛利率 30% → LTV=1: Average order value 100, 12 purchases a year, a 3-year lifetime and a 30% gross margin give LTV = 100×12×3×30% = 1080 CNY.
map.月收入 MRR=50、毛利率 30%、月流失率 10% → 生命周期=1/10%: With MRR = 50, gross margin 30% and monthly churn 10%, lifetime = 1/10% = 10 months and LTV = (50×30%)/10% = 150 CNY (monthly revenue basis).
